chapter.title: EXECUTION, SUSPENSION, REMISSION AND COMMUTATION OF SENTENCES

heading: Postponement of capital sentence on pregnant woman.
text:
If a woman sentenced to death is found to be pregnant, the High Court shall [1][****], commute the sentence to imprisonment for life.
B.—Imprisonment
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Certain words omitted by Act 5 of 2009, s. 30 (w.e.f. 31-12-2009).
